note: Every non-null member is ENFORCED by harness/pins.py before a registered attempt starts and before any adjudication; a registered attempt refuses to run under any null or mismatching pin, and a pilot is an explicit mode (--pilot) whose marker says PILOT. The manifest covers neither itself nor this file; this file pins the manifest; the freeze commit anchors this file.

gateway.build: cd go && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -o gateway . (Go 1.26.5 linux/amd64; the build is reproducible: two builds gave the same digest)
gateway.publicKeyNote: corpus/TEST-PUBLIC-KEY of the gateway repository at the pinned commit: the key the corpus vectors are signed under, never a secret

baseline.vector: corpus/v3/stores/v3-action-valid.json at the pinned gateway commit
baseline.materializedAs: fixtures/baseline/{store,registry.jsonl,decisions,AUTHORITY}; attestations bound by adapter/bind.py under the adapter key

securesystemslib.role: the DSSE reference implementation (Envelope, CryptoSigner, SSlibKey)

cryptography.role: the Ed25519 primitive securesystemslib verifies with

protobuf.role: the message runtime the in-toto-attestation bindings validate with

intoto.note: installed with pip into a virtual environment; the digest is over the distribution's files in RECORD order, bytes included, so a patched installation does not pass as the release; and the module each package is imported from must be a file of that distribution (import origins are checked), so a package shadowing the installation under a prepended path does not pass either

adapter.note: the study-minted Ed25519 key derived from a fixed seed in adapter/bind.py; not a secret, not the gateway's key

harnessPython.note: the interpreter of the virtual environment the packages are installed in, enforced exactly; the marker and the observations record it
